sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:66374
Court No. - 73

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 12189 of 2024
Applicant :- Nausad

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Kamlesh Kumar Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.
Heard Sri Dileep Singh Yadav, Advocate holding brief of Sri K.K. Singh, learned counsel for the applicant and Dr. S.B. Maurya, learned AGA-I for the State.

2. The instant bail application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 115 of 2023, under Sections 60/63 Excise Act and Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471 IPC, Police Station Naugarh, District Chandauli during pendency of the trial.
3. FIR of the present case was lodged against two persons (non applicant) and according to the FIR from a DCM 386 Cartoons of foreign liquor was recovered.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant was not named in the FIR but during investigation when it was revealed that applicant was owner of the vehicle then he was made accused in the present matter.

Nausad vs State Of U.P. on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/28599232/
1 5.

He further submits that actually applicant sold his vehicle to one Sanjeev Kumar Upadhyay on 10.09.2023 and recovery of alleged liquor was made on 20.09.2023, therefore, even if recovery was made from the DCM which was still in the name of applicant, then also applicant cannot be held liable.
6.
He further submits that applicant is not having any criminal history and in the present matter he is in jail since 14.02.2024.

7. Per contra, learned AGA however opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the argument on facts advanced by learned counsel for the applicant including the fact that even earlier to the alleged recovery, applicant has already sold his vehicle to some other person.
8. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

9. However, from the record, it reflects that from the vehicle of the applicant huge quantity of foreign liquor was recovered but recovery was made on 20.09.2023 and even earlier i.e. on 10.09.2023 applicant has already sold his vehicle to one Sanjeev Kumar Upadhyay and this fact has specifically averred in paragraph-7 to the affidavit and learned AGA could not controvert the averment made in paragraph-7 to the affidavit.
10.
Further, applicant is not having any criminal history and in the present matter he is in jail since 14.02.2024.

11. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case discussed above, in my view,
applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
12. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

13. Let the applicant - Nausad be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.

(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
14.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

Nausad vs State Of U.P. on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/28599232/
2 15.

It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.

Order Date :- 16.4.2024 AK Pandey  Nausad vs State Of U.P. on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/28599232/
